description: Defines the QuicChromiumPacketWriter class for writing QUIC packets over datagram sockets, including nested ReusableIOBuffer class and Delegate interface, with methods for packet writing, error handling, and socket management.

classes.name: QuicChromiumPacketWriter
classes.description: A Chrome-specific QUIC packet writer utilizing datagram sockets for data transmission.

classes.name: ReusableIOBuffer
classes.description: A reusable IOBuffer class for efficient packet data management.

classes.name: Delegate
classes.description: Interface for socket write event notifications and error handling.

methods.name: set_delegate
methods.description: Sets the delegate for write event notifications.

methods.name: set_force_write_blocked
methods.description: Forces the writer to be in a blocked state.

methods.name: WritePacketToSocket
methods.description: Writes a packet to the socket.

methods.name: WritePacket
methods.description: Implements the quic::QuicPacketWriter interface to write packets.

methods.name: IsWriteBlocked
methods.description: Checks if writing is currently blocked.

methods.name: MessageTooBigErrorCode
methods.description: Returns error code if message size exceeds maximum.

methods.name: GetMaxPacketSize
methods.description: Returns maximum packet size for a given peer address.

methods.name: SupportsReleaseTime
methods.description: Indicates support for release time feature.

methods.name: IsBatchMode
methods.description: Indicates if batch mode is supported.

methods.name: GetNextWriteLocation
methods.description: Provides the next buffer location for writing.
